seed_shelf.slot_order: left to right: potato, tomato, pumpkin, peapod, cherries
seed_shelf.note: Empty wooden crate. Do not bake packets into the shelf — they remain tappable sprites.
seed_shelf.recommended_packet_scale_note: Scale applied to each 512×512 seed_packet_*.png when the shelf is composited at native 1024. At 0.36 the packet body fills about 85–90% of a slot's width (~140px). If the shelf is drawn at another size, keep the same ratio: packet_px = 512 * recommended_packet_scale * (shelf_draw_size / 1024). The shelf art is a wide 5-slot crate, so a small in-scene shelf will make packets look tiny — prefer showing the shelf closer to native 1024 for the seed-picker UI.

bed_area.note: Recommended placement of soil_bed (visual bbox after cropping transparent padding), centered horizontally in the middle third, with the seed shelf above-left and not overlapping.

bg_portrait.note: Middle third (y 640–1280) is the bed play area. Bottom third (y 1280–1920) stays plain for a question-card overlay. Top third is open sky.
